compat_note: Ollama 0.33.0 compiles response_format json_schema into a GBNF grammar and rejects the \d shorthand: '^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$' fails with 'failed to parse grammar', '^T[0-9]{4}(\.[0-9]{3})?$' compiles. The production schema is NOT changed; this transform is applied only to make the path executable, and it is semantically identical for ASCII technique IDs.
timeout_note: Connector REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 45s. A single extraction with the full schema took ~50s on this hardware, so the benchmark raised it to 900s. On this machine the production timeout would fail every request.
